items.title: Olympus (KeyMed) wins £37k direct-award for Betsi Cadwaladr endoscopy scopes and drying cabinet
items.summary: Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board has directly awarded KeyMed (Medical & Industrial Equipment) Limited, Olympus's UK medical device business, a £37,015.66 contract for endoscopy scopes and stacks including a drying cabinet, for use at Wrexham Maelor Hospital.

items.title: Hepatitis A infections identified in Newcastle primary schools
items.summary: Two hepatitis A cases have been identified at primary schools in Newcastle, officials from the UK Health Security Agency (UKHSA) have confirmed.
